about: Advanced-pull camp through a closed door. On Shadowfang Keep's doubling-back entrance, the crowded zone-in keeps resetting the breadcrumb trail. ComputeSafeCamp's starved-trail fallback projected the camp straight away from the pack, which pointed FORWARD onto or past the shut Courtyard Door (GO 20835 at -242.6,2159,90.6) while the tank was still fighting toward Rethilgore (memory dc-pull-camp-forward-door). The door guard 059f7b0f missed it, because the door sits at the top of a ramp out of the chord's Z band. Fixed in 328dc5d5: the fallback walks back along the travelled escort polyline (PointBehind). The scenario starts the party at a real zone-in position (tr-20260925-175048-2) with the trail empty and forces an advanced pull on the Rethilgore-room pack. The door is closed at t=0. Rethilgore is the objective, so he is always kept, and he stands 7.5yd from the Bleak Worg: he joins every pull of this pack (both runs of lb-20261003-155828-1), hence O7 outsideMax 1.
